readiness.hed: Frost advisory until 9 a.m., then sun and a high near 68. Tonight drops to about 36.
readiness.insight: A frost advisory is in effect for Fredericksburg until 9 a.m. EDT. The National Weather Service says temperatures as low as 33 can put frost on tender plants, and uncovered plants may be killed. After the frost and patchy fog between 8 and 10 a.m., today is sunny, a high near 68, northeast wind around 3 mph. Tonight is clear, with patchy fog between 8 p.m. and 3 a.m., then more patchy frost, and a low around 36.
